paragraphs: I'm excited to apply for the Security Engineering role at Ramp. Your commitment to building a secure and intelligent financial operations platform aligns perfectly with my background in developing robust data tooling and infrastructure security.

My core strengths lie in Python (Flask) and systems-level development, focusing on creating secure, observable, and scalable software solutions. I have extensive experience working across cloud environments like AWS, Azure, and GCP, containerizing applications with Docker/Kubernetes, provisioning resources with Terraform, and implementing CI/CD pipelines to ensure testability and version control.

In my previous role, I led the consolidation of diverse enterprise systems into a unified platform using tools such as Rapid7, Jamf, and BigFix. This project automated workflows from data aggregation to remediation, reducing manual effort by over 100 hours per month and enhancing visibility and response capabilities across thousands of endpoints.

I am adept at owning the entire lifecycle of a solution, from design through deployment and operations. My projects have included robust system architecture, strong authentication and secrets management, disciplined monitoring and alerting to maintain high availability and performance.
